findings.message: <div id="el-captions"> looks like captions but is not marked as such, so the timeline cannot group it on the caption track.

findings.message: GSAP tweens overlap on "#a01-glow" for scale between 2.78s and 3.10s.
findings.fixHint: Shorten the earlier tween, move the later tween, or add `overwrite: "auto"`.

findings.message: <div class="f02-qualidade-prazos-bg" data-start="0" data-track-index="0"> has no id, so Studio cannot use a stable edit target for its timeline and canvas controls.
findings.fixHint: Add a stable, human-readable id such as id="hero-title" or id="scene-1-card" to every timeline-visible element you want agents or Studio to edit.

findings.message: Selector "#root [id="05-passe-o-mouse-bg"]" sets left/top through [id=...] or :where(#id), which has class-level or zero specificity, so a compound class rule (e.g. ".parent .row") on the same element can silently win over this override.
findings.fixHint: Use `#\30 5-passe-o-mouse-bg` instead; id specificity beats any selector built only from classes.
